guideline: Drive the add-layer dialog from GetCapabilities: list layer names and titles, supported CRS, styles and the scale range, instead of asking users to type layer names.
keywords: getcapabilities; add layer; wms; wmts; wfs; layer list; crs; styles; catalog; service url
do: Request GetCapabilities, parse layers, CRS, styles and scale range, and let the user pick; prefer a CRS the map already uses.
dont: Make users type layer names and CRS by hand.
code_good: const xml = await (await fetch(url+'?service=WMS&request=GetCapabilities')).text(); const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(xml,'text/xml');

guideline: Run identify only on layers marked queryable in the capabilities; send queries to those layers and no others.
keywords: queryable; getfeatureinfo; identify; query_layers; wms; click; non-queryable
do: Filter to Layer[queryable=1] and disable identify on other layers with a visible reason.
dont: Send GetFeatureInfo for every visible layer.

guideline: Prefer WFS over WMS GetFeatureInfo when you need feature attributes; GetFeatureInfo returns text or HTML meant for display, WFS returns structured features.
keywords: wfs; getfeature; getfeatureinfo; attributes; identify; geojson; outputFormat; structured
do: Fetch attributes with WFS GetFeature (outputFormat=application/json) and build the popup yourself; use GetFeatureInfo only when no WFS exists.
dont: Parse HTML returned by GetFeatureInfo to extract attribute values.

guideline: Build WMS legends with GetLegendGraphic: pass SCALE so rules outside the current scale drop out, and LEGEND_OPTIONS=hideEmptyRules:true together with BBOX so empty rules in the view are hidden.
keywords: wms legend; getlegendgraphic; legend_options; hideEmptyRules; scale; bbox; legend graphic; legendurl
do: Refresh the legend when scale or extent changes, passing SCALE, BBOX and hideEmptyRules; label it with the layer title (see Y09, S14).
dont: Show one static legend image for all scales.

guideline: Respect MinScaleDenominator and MaxScaleDenominator from the capabilities: turn them into the layer visible range, and grey out the layer outside it (see Y02, Y03).
keywords: minscaledenominator; maxscaledenominator; scale range; visible range; scale denominator; wms; zoom range
do: Convert denominators to zoom levels or scales, show the range in the layer list and grey out out-of-range layers.
dont: Request tiles the service will return blank at this scale, or hide the reason.
code_bad: layer.setVisible(true); // blank image at wrong scale

guideline: Never put credentials in OGC service URLs: query strings leak through logs, history and referrers. Send them in headers or through your own proxy.
keywords: credentials; token; api key; auth; authorization; url secret; basic auth; proxy; headers
do: Send an Authorization header from fetch, or route the service through a server proxy that adds the secret.
dont: Append ?token= or user:pass@ to the service URL.

guideline: Browsers block cross-origin OGC requests unless the server sends CORS headers. If you cannot enable CORS, use a same-origin proxy; also surface service exceptions as per-layer errors (see P06).
keywords: cors; proxy; cross origin; service exception; error; wms; blocked; access-control-allow-origin
do: Enable CORS on the service or proxy it, and show a per-layer error with retry when a request or ServiceException fails.
dont: Fail silently or show a blank layer when the service errors.
code_good: const r = await fetch('/proxy/wms?'+qs); if (!r.ok) showLayerError(id, r.status);
code_bad: fetch(url); // blocked by CORS, no error shown

guideline: Render GetFeatureInfo HTML only after sanitizing it, or in a sandboxed iframe; otherwise show text. Service output is untrusted (see I10).
keywords: getfeatureinfo; html; sanitize; xss; innerHTML; sandbox iframe; text/plain; popup
do: Request info_format=text/plain or application/json when possible, and sanitize or sandbox any HTML.
dont: Assign GetFeatureInfo HTML straight to innerHTML.
